title: AgentPluginMcpManifestV1
description: Vendored agent-plugins.org 1.0.0 mcp.json schema (pinned; see plugin/schemas/pins.json for the recorded sha256, invariant I4 — no runtime fetching). Only the stdio transport is modeled: command/args/env/cwd support ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/${PLUGIN_DATA} expansion, checked for plugin-root containment by plugin/validate.mjs (a path-safety rule, not expressible in JSON Schema alone).
